# pf-audit

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from libs/platform-pf/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/pf-audit.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `pf-audit` component of `libs/platform-pf`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.platform.pf.audit`: generated from its catalogue, pf-audit.json, by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Families: `OIDF_EVENTS_`. A name under one of these that no catalogue declares is an unknown key.

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `FEDERATION`, `AUTO_REGISTRATION`, `ATTESTATION_AUTH`, `ATTESTATION_ISSUER`, `HOSTING`, `SSF`, `SSF_RECEIVER`, `OPERATOR_API`, `FAPI` (components).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OIDF_EVENTS_AUDIT` (system property `oidf.events.audit`, then env `OIDF_EVENTS_AUDIT`) | `true` | Whether events marked as audit also go to PingFederate's audit.log; every event goes to server.log either way | **Doesn't start**: Neither true nor false, in any case: audit stays on, with an ERROR naming the setting, and under production the start-up audit refuses every component, since it cannot tell whether the value asks for audit off. Under development yes, no, 1, 0, on and off keep audit on too, with a warning: this setting does not read them as false | In production only as accepted risk `audit-off`: `false`; refuses `FEDERATION`, `AUTO_REGISTRATION`, `ATTESTATION_AUTH`, `ATTESTATION_ISSUER`, `HOSTING`, `SSF`, `SSF_RECEIVER`, `OPERATOR_API`, `FAPI` | Yes |
| `OIDF_EVENTS_MAX_VALUE_LENGTH` | `512`; a whole number, at least 16 | The longest value an event line carries; a longer one is cut | **Not checked**: Not a whole number, or below 16: refused with an ERROR naming the setting, and event values keep the cap they had (512 unless something set another) | Any | No |
